title: Sidecar merge-watch: auto-recover a stuck auto-merge (OPEN+BEHIND -> gh pr update-branch) instead of polling silently to 4h timeout
description: In ci-gated mode with strict branch protection, a PR whose branch is BEHIND main never auto-merges (strict requires up-to-date). merge-watch stepPoll (src/release/merge-watch.ts:452) returns null for OPEN + non-BLOCKED (CLEAN/BEHIND/DIRTY), so on BEHIND the sidecar just keeps polling for up to 4h (240x60s) then times out, never merging. This is recurring: every ci-gated ship where main advanced during the cycle (specify + issue-file commits land on main) produces a BEHIND branch. Lived in CAM-179 ship (PR #130 sat OPEN+BEHIND; operator had to hand-run gh pr update-branch). Fix: when OPEN+BEHIND and auto-merge is armed, the sidecar should run gh pr update-branch (bounded retries, e.g. max 2-3) to catch the branch up, then keep watching; the re-run CI + armed auto-merge then closes it. Handle DIRTY (real merge conflict) by narrating + stopping the watch (needs a worker/human, not auto-recoverable). ci-red already narrates+stops. Complements CAM-170 (surface poll failures): CAM-170 signals the stall, this auto-recovers it. Guard: do not update-branch on ci-red or DIRTY; only on BEHIND with no failed check.

spec.scope: Make the sidecar merge-watch auto-recover a PR stuck at OPEN+BEHIND under strict branch protection, and durably surface non-recoverable merge-watch terminals so a recycled orchestrator learns the ship stalled. (1) Auto-recover: in processPollResult, when state OPEN and mergeStateStatus BEHIND and auto-merge is armed, run gh pr update-branch via a new injectable updateBranchFn (production wraps env -u GITHUB_TOKEN gh pr update-branch <N>), capped at 2 attempts tracked in MergeWatchState.updateBranchCount, then keep polling so the re-run CI plus armed auto-merge closes the PR. Extend the gh poll JSON with autoMergeRequest to gate on armed. DIRTY (real conflict) and cap-exhausted are non-recoverable: stop the watch. (2) Durable escalation: on any non-merged terminal (behind-unrecovered, dirty, ci-red, closed, timeout) emit logEvent merge-watch-stalled with reason/prNumber/issueId and write a durable marker .claude/.cam-ship-stalled.json; keep the existing notifyOrchestrator send-keys as a live-orchestrator fast path. (3) Consumption: add a boot step to subagent-orchestrator.md that reads the stalled marker and surfaces it as an opening blocker; consume the marker automatically when a subsequent watch merges the same PR. Out of scope: general unification with CAM-170, auto-resolving DIRTY conflicts, and changing the 4h poll timeout.
acceptanceCriteria: When a poll returns OPEN + mergeStateStatus BEHIND with auto-merge armed (autoMergeRequest non-null) and updateBranchCount < 2, stepMergeWatch calls updateBranchFn(prNumber), increments updateBranchCount in MergeWatchState, and the watch continues with no terminal outcome.
When updateBranchCount === 2 and a poll still returns OPEN + BEHIND, the watch terminates non-merged with reason behind-unrecovered and updateBranchFn is not called again.
When a poll returns OPEN + BEHIND but auto-merge is not armed (autoMergeRequest null), updateBranchFn is not called.
When a poll returns OPEN + DIRTY, the watch terminates non-merged with reason dirty and updateBranchFn is not called.

On every non-merged terminal (behind-unrecovered, dirty, ci-red, closed, timeout), a merge-watch-stalled event is emitted via logEvent and .claude/.cam-ship-stalled.json is written with prNumber, prUrl, issueId, reason, and ts.
The production updateBranchFn runs gh pr update-branch with GITHUB_TOKEN stripped from the environment; the read-only gh pr view poll keeps the token.
When a later watch reaches MERGED for the same prNumber, the .claude/.cam-ship-stalled.json marker is removed.
subagent-orchestrator.md boot documents reading .claude/.cam-ship-stalled.json and surfacing it as an opening blocker; a clean boot with no marker surfaces nothing.
Unit tests cover BEHIND+armed to update+continue, BEHIND cap to terminate, BEHIND not-armed to no-update, DIRTY to terminate, and marker written on terminal plus removed on a later merge.
gotchas: gh pr update-branch is a mutation: the .env GITHUB_TOKEN (fine-grained PAT) lacks Pull requests: write, so it must run under env -u GITHUB_TOKEN to fall back to the keyring OAuth token (same as gh pr create/merge/comment). Do NOT strip the token on the read-only gh pr view poll.
Right after update-branch the mergeStateStatus flips to BLOCKED/UNSTABLE (CI re-running), not back to BEHIND, so the cap is only spent when main advances AGAIN. Do not gate the cap on pollCount.
The durable channel already exists: reuse the logEvent (cam-worker-events.jsonl) and notifyOrchestrator seams; do not invent a third narration channel (single-pusher invariant CAM-78).
The stalled marker .claude/.cam-ship-stalled.json is a SEPARATE file from .cam-merge-watch.json, which is consume-on-read and deleted on any terminal. Do not overload the merge-watch state file.

The orchestrator boot template is cam dual-copy per-file: templates/agents/subagent-orchestrator.md, .claude/agents/subagent-orchestrator.md, and the generated vendor copy. Verify all copies and re-embed the vendor copy if the .claude source changed.
General unification of all merge-watch terminal outcomes and CAM-170 poll-errors onto one durable channel is out of scope: CAM-170 owns that as a consumer of the merge-watch-stalled event.
gh pr view must be extended to fetch autoMergeRequest so the armed-gate can be evaluated; PrStatus gains an auto-merge-armed signal.
